title: Form is not different from emptiness
subtitle: Heart Sutra
timeLabel: Sui–Tang Chinese translation and circulation context
shortSummary: This line circulated widely in Chinese Buddhism, but it must be read within its paragraph and textual version.
curatorialDescription: ‘Form is not different from emptiness’ is not a context-free slogan. It belongs to a sustained discussion of the relation between form and emptiness and shows how Prajñāpāramitā thought entered Chinese Buddhist contexts through translated scripture.
researchNote: The Alpha entry is linked to text and version entities; translator, base edition, variants and a more precise locator remain to be added.

quote.original: 色不异空，空不异色。色即是空，空即是色。
quote.interpretation: Form and emptiness are not isolated realities; the passage continues by extending the discussion to feeling, perception, formations and consciousness.
quote.locator: Heart Sutra: form is not different from emptiness
